reason: This is a methodological appraisal of AAA clinical practice guidelines using AGREE II, not a primary study measuring any marker.

The GWAS/blood-meQTL/SMR analysis of disordered eating links methylation to genetic variant effects on disease susceptibility, not to a modifiable exposure or a stated clinical/public-health decision.
The study measures telomere length by qPCR, which is not DNA methylation, histone modification, chromatin state, or an epigenetic clock.

gamma-H2AX (a histone modification) and pATM were measured by staining in ex vivo cultured biopsies from a cohort of 28 oral/oropharyngeal cancer patients and related to prediction of treatment response.
25 DNA methylation CpG loci were measured in the Framingham cohort and combined with clinical features to predict early HFpEF risk, a clinical risk-stratification use.
Peripheral blood DNA methylation microarrays were compared between successful and normal cognitive aging groups in a community-dwelling older-adult case-control sample.
DNA methylation and epigenetic age acceleration measures in GENOA African-American cohort blood samples were related to multi-site atherosclerosis risk over 5-12 years follow-up.
Whole-blood DNA methylation (Infinium 450k) epigenetic age acceleration was assessed against change in frailty in the MOBILIZE Boston cohort, a prognosis-relevant biomarker use.
Five DNA methylation age clocks were measured in the Berlin Aging Study II/GendAge cohort and related to functional capacity outcomes cross-sectionally and longitudinally.
Genomic DNA methylation was directly profiled (EWAS) in individual-level case and control blood/leukocyte samples across two validation phases to identify pancreatic cancer susceptibility loci.
DunedinPACE, a DNA-methylation blood-test biomarker of pace of aging, was developed and validated against morbidity, disability, and mortality in the Dunedin birth cohort and other human datasets.

Epigenome-wide DNA methylation in CSF samples from a prospective cohort of 89 severe TBI patients was linked to intracranial hypertension severity, informing risk stratification and personalized therapy.

The study measures H2AFZ mRNA and protein expression levels in LUAD tissue via IHC/bioinformatics, which is expression of a histone variant rather than a measured chromatin-state or modification mark.
This study of Geriatric Assessment components predicting surgical outcomes measures no epigenetic marker of any kind.
Tissue and cell-free DNA methylation blocks were directly measured by bisulfite sequencing and used to build and validate an HCC screening/diagnostic model in patient plasma cohorts.
This retrospective study of breast cancer brain metastases reports only cytopathology and IHC receptor/Ki67 status, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation signatures (EpiScores) for the circulating proteome were trained/tested in four cohorts and related to incident disease risk in Generation Scotland.
This study of DSC-MRI/ADC imaging differentiating H3-mutant from H3-wild-type glioma uses imaging parameters, not a directly measured epigenetic marker, to classify tumors.
The SIOP Ependymoma I non-randomised trial evaluated DNA methylation and H3K27me3 histone modification status in tumor samples from treated children and related them to event-free/overall survival.
Genome-wide infant cord-blood DNA methylation (EPIC array) was related to maternal and neonatal one-carbon metabolite exposures in the MMIP pregnancy cohort.
This cohort of 220 methylation-class-PXA tumors used DNA methylation array analysis to define tumor classification and related pTERT mutation status to prognosis.
Cohort data (N=3205) were used to directly measure DNA hypomethylation at F2RL3 in blood and relate it to smoking exposure and myocardial infarction risk via platelet reactivity.
Cognitive function is assessed via serum metabolomics (amino acids, neurotransmitters) to build a biological-age model; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Global DNA methylation and chromatin remodeling/histone modifications were measured in buffy-coat samples from patients with neurodegenerative disorders for diagnostic biomarker discovery.
Placental LEP gene DNA methylation at 13 CpG sites was measured in the STORK-Groruddalen cohort and related to maternal glucose/LDL-cholesterol, a modifiable metabolic exposure.
DNA methylation (850K array) was measured in Gambian and Indian children's blood and related to cardiometabolic risk factors (blood pressure, insulin, lipids) in the EMPHASIS study.
GrimAge and Pace of Aging DNA methylation clocks were measured in TILDA cohort blood samples and related to childhood adversity exposure in this cross-sectional study.
Methylation status of SOSTDC1, DACT2, and WIF1 was measured by methylation-specific PCR in plasma samples of a breast cancer case-control cohort for diagnostic biomarker validation.

ZFP64 chromatin binding (ChIP-seq) was investigated mechanistically in cell lines and mouse/humanized-mouse tumor models; the human patient samples were used only for RNA-seq, not epigenetic marker measurement.
Newborn DNA methylation (CpGs) was measured in cord blood of the Isle of Wight Birth Cohort and related to asthma acquisition during adolescence/young adulthood, replicated in ALSPAC.

This case-control study of morphine abuse in men used Aniline Blue/Toluidine Blue/CMA3 sperm chromatin integrity stains, which the instrument specifies measure DNA strand breakage/packaging rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
H3K27M mutation status (a genetic alteration) was assessed in adult thalamic glioma patients, but no histone modification, methylation, or chromatin-state assay was directly measured.
Genome-wide tumor DNA methylation was measured pre- and on-treatment in patients enrolled in this single-arm phase 2 trial of pembrolizumab plus the demethylating agent azacitidine.

The abstract states DNA methylation profiling datasets were analyzed across ICC mutational clusters but does not specify whether this was individual-level primary/secondary data or only aggregate published findings.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation was measured in PBMCs of ankylosing spondylitis cases versus healthy controls (with independent validation cohort), linking methylation to disease diagnosis/mechanism.

SNRPN methylation-specific quantitative melt analysis directly measured DNA methylation in newborn blood spots to validate feasibility of population-scale screening for chromosome 15 imprinting disorders.

Multiple DNA-methylation-based epigenetic age acceleration measures were assessed in the Head and Neck 5000 prospective cohort and shown to predict all-cause mortality in oropharyngeal cancer patients.
MLH1 promoter methylation status was assessed alongside MMRP immunohistochemistry in a retrospective series of endometrial carcinomas to inform Lynch syndrome screening follow-up.
DNA methylation of three PTEN promoter sequences was measured by pyrosequencing in tumor tissue from a breast cancer cohort (validated in TCGA) and predicted 10-year survival after tamoxifen therapy.
MGMT promoter methylation status was retrospectively assessed in tumor tissue from 316 wild-type IDH glioblastoma patients and related to clinicopathological parameters and treatment response.
ZNF582 promoter methylation was measured in lesion and adjacent-normal tissue across OLP, dysplasia, and OSCC patient groups in this case-control study, informing malignant-transformation monitoring.
This cross-sectional study directly measured MGMT promoter methylation status by PCR (gold standard) and IHC in glioma patient tissue samples to evaluate diagnostic accuracy for treatment decisions.
OKI-179 is characterized in vitro and in preclinical tumor models; the human phase I trial is only mentioned as ongoing/future work with no reported results.
Hyper-methylated CLIP4 (measured by methylation-specific PCR) was validated as a serum/tissue biomarker for colorectal cancer diagnosis in training and validation patient cohorts.
DNA methylation status at 16 CpG sites of tumor-derived genomic DNA was measured (MethyLight-based assay) in 186 mCRC patients and predicted response to anti-EGFR treatment.
Promoter methylation of FBN1, SPG20, ITF2, RUNX3, SNCA, MLH1, and SEPT9 was directly measured in tissue and plasma cfDNA of a colorectal cancer case-control cohort for diagnostic biomarker discovery.
Multimodal MR imaging variables were used to predict H3 K27M mutation status noninvasively; no epigenetic marker was directly measured in this retrospective imaging study.
Pace of Aging here was measured from 12 physiological biomarkers across body systems, not a DNA-methylation-based epigenetic clock, so no eligible marker was measured.
IDH1/2 mutations were identified by direct sequencing in leukemia patients; DNA methylation itself was not measured, only discussed as a downstream consequence of mutation.
Blood DNA methylation at 45 FOXO3 CpGs (HumanMethylation450) was measured across eight case-control cancer studies and a mortality cohort and related to cancer survival.
Genome-wide blood DNA methylation was measured across WHI, ARIC, and MESA cohorts and CpG sites were related to BMI, metabolic health, and incident coronary heart disease risk.

DNA-methylation-based telomere length (DNAmTL), an epigenetic clock-family biomarker, was measured in blood of COPD patients in the MACRO trial placebo arm and predicted exacerbation/hospitalization risk.

DNA methylation array was used for molecular (subgroup) classification of embryonal brain tumors in this prospective pediatric trial (PBTC-026), with methylation-defined subgroup linked to progression-free/overall survival.
This EPIC-Heidelberg case-cohort study examines GDF-15, NT-proBNP, HbA1c, CRP, and cystatin-C, none of which are epigenetic markers.

The abstract describes H3K27me3/H3K4me3 and genome-wide DNA methylation changes driven by lncRNA H19 in mechanistic/model studies, and separately cites clinical H19 expression data in patients, without clearly stating that the epigenetic marks themselves were measured in the human patient cohort.
DNA methylation at 840 CpG sites in FGFR/FGF/CCND1 genes was measured in TCGA HNSCC tumor and normal tissue samples and correlated with HPV status and predicted sensitivity to FGFR inhibitors.
DNA methylation was measured as a candidate biomarker of treatment response in this randomized phase 2 trial of azacitidine with/without durvalumab in older AML patients.
This cross-sectional survey of physicians' and pharmacists' prediabetes management views measures no epigenetic marker.
Blood leukocyte DNA methylation age acceleration (Horvath, Hannum, GrimAge, and other clocks) was measured in CHAMACOS study children and related to maternal adverse childhood experiences exposure.
This is a study protocol for the RENaBack multicenter RCT describing planned work, with no data reported and no epigenetic marker involved.
Cord blood DNA methylation age (Horvath and Knight clocks) was measured in the PROGRESS birth cohort and examined for association with prenatal lead exposure, a modifiable environmental exposure.
Epigenetic age (DNA methylation clocks) was measured in a randomized controlled trial of metformin and weight loss interventions in overweight postmenopausal breast cancer survivors.
This retrospective MRI study compares imaging characteristics between H3 K27M mutant and wild-type pediatric glioma groups defined by mutation status, without directly measuring an epigenetic marker.
DNA methylation-derived inflammatory measures (mdNLR and CRP-linked methylation loci) were measured in blood of a nested case-control study and related to lung cancer risk and survival.

Whole blood DNA methylome (Illumina 850K array) was directly measured in patients with different glucocorticoid states (Cushing's syndrome, eucortisolism, adrenal insufficiency) to build a diagnostic biomarker.

This retrospective exome sequencing cohort identifies pathogenic gene variants in BAF chromatin-remodeling complex subunits; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state assay was performed.
Genome-wide DNA methylation episignatures (Illumina EPIC array) were measured in blood of a cohort of 129 individuals with suspected chromatinopathies to improve molecular diagnosis.

This study measures allelic gene expression (imprinting status) by QCIGISH in situ hybridization as a diagnostic biomarker for lung cancer, which reflects gene expression rather than a directly measured DNA methylation or chromatin mark.
The Bladder EpiCheck test, based on DNA methylation changes in 15 genomic biomarkers, was measured in voided urine of a prospective cohort of NMIBC patients for post-treatment surveillance.
LINE-1 DNA methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in leukocyte DNA of 488 women in this cross-sectional study and related to BMI and obesity status.

This pan-cancer bioinformatic study focuses on TMC gene expression and immunotherapy response prediction; DNA methylation is only mentioned in passing as a regulatory mechanism without being directly analyzed or reported.

DNA-methylation-derived epigenetic age acceleration was measured at midlife in a 30-year prospective cohort study and shown to moderate cortisol trajectories following childhood sexual abuse exposure.
This study of the lupus band test measures anti-chromatin autoantibodies (a serologic assay), not a directly measured DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state marker.

Newborn cord blood DNA methylation (epigenome-wide) was measured in the Drakenstein Child Health Study and associated with severe neurodevelopmental delay at 2 years, an early-detection/risk-stratification use.

450K DNA methylation profiling was used to determine molecular subgroup in medulloblastoma patients treated on this phase III trial (SJMB03), and subgroup was linked to distinct failure patterns guiding treatment strategy.

DNA methylation of immune-related genes was analyzed using individual-level TARGET/GEO osteosarcoma patient data to define immune-methylation patient subgroups linked to prognosis and immunotherapy rationale.
Genome-wide DNA methylation data from 646 individual TCGA/GEO lower-grade-glioma patients were used to build and validate a two-CpG methylation signature for prognosis and risk stratification.
The iColocomf dual-target stool DNA methylation test was measured in a multicenter case-control cohort of 1164 participants to evaluate diagnostic performance for colorectal cancer detection.
This study analyzes NF-Y transcription factor subunit expression and TCGA molecular subtypes in gastric adenocarcinoma; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state assay is measured.

DNA methylation of TNF, IL1B, and IL6 genes was measured by EPIC array and pyrosequencing in pre- and post-neurosurgery blood of epilepsy patients to build a diagnostic index for postoperative delirium.
IL-6 promoter methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in cumulus cells of women undergoing IVF and compared between smokers and non-smokers, a modifiable exposure.
Genome-wide DNA methylation and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine were directly measured in circulating neutrophils of pregnant women and compared between normal, mild, and severe preeclampsia groups.
LEP promoter methylation was measured by MethyLight assay in formalin-fixed ovarian cancer tumor tissue and was a significant prognostic factor for recurrence and disease-specific survival.
AKT3 promoter hypomethylation was analyzed using individual-level testicular germ cell tumor methylation data (DiseaseMeth/GEO) and correlated with survival outcomes, alongside in vitro validation.
DNA methylation of three FYB gene CpG sites was measured by bisulfite-based assay in peripheral blood of a case-control study of early-stage lung cancer patients versus matched controls.
The only epigenetic-adjacent marker measured in humans is expression of the long noncoding RNA CYTOR; the chromatin-accessibility mechanism was shown only in mouse cells, not human participants.

DNA methylation profiles were measured in a reference cohort of 405 primary HNSC tumor samples and used to develop/validate machine-learning classifiers predicting the primary site of HNSC metastases of unknown origin.

Genome-wide blood DNA methylation (Illumina EPIC BeadChip) was measured before and after acupuncture treatment in a cohort of 11 burnout patients, linking methylation change to a modifiable intervention.

Cord blood DNA methylation (EPIC array) was measured at birth in a twin birth cohort and associated with dental caries and hypomineralization outcomes at age six, suggesting early risk-stratification biomarkers.

This retrospective pathology study of dermatomyositis measures myositis-specific autoantibodies and IHC muscle pathology features (including anti-Mi-2 antibodies), not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
This prospective study of a glucose management team's effect on glycaemic care in arthroplasty patients measures no epigenetic marker.
This retrospective series on esophageal differentiated-type dysplasia reports histology, TP53 mutation, and Ki-67 IHC, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Genome-wide 5-hydroxymethylcytosine profiles were measured directly in circulating cell-free DNA of a case-control study of late-onset Alzheimer's disease patients versus cognitively normal controls.
A 4-gene DNA methylation biomarker panel was measured in tissue and cell-free DNA of a case-control study to evaluate diagnostic accuracy for early pancreatic cancer detection.
DNA methylation was measured epigenome-wide in blood of 8161 individuals and associated with alcohol consumption, a modifiable exposure, with cross-validation in AUD cohorts.

Global DNA methylation (colorimetric ELISA) was measured cross-sectionally in blood of individuals from low- and high-air-pollution areas in North India and related to homocysteine and B-vitamin status.

Sperm DNA methylation (450K array and targeted CpG bisulfite sequencing) was directly measured and compared between heavy smokers and non-smokers, separate from the sperm chromatin condensation/fragmentation measures also reported.
A three-CpG DNA methylation signature was identified using TCGA lung adenocarcinoma data and validated in an independent Chinese patient cohort for prognosis prediction.
Multiple DNA-methylation-based biological aging clocks were measured in blood of Health and Retirement Study participants and used to test Black-White disparities in healthspan-related outcomes.

Alongside mouse experiments, genome-wide promoter DNA methylation at birth was measured in human cohort/RCT participants and related to maternal plasma folate and folic acid supplementation, a modifiable exposure.
